# Sun Optics: full reference

Sun Optics is an optician in Vellore, Tamil Nadu, serving the community since December 1999.

## About
Founded by Mr. Balaji, a qualified optometrist (trained 1988 at the Regional Institute of Ophthalmology, Egmore; began at L V Prasad Eye Institute and Lawrence & Mayo; later Al Jabir Opticians, Doha). Mr. Yashwanth Balaji, B.Optom (2023), completed a contact lens fellowship at Sankara Nethralaya, Chennai, and joined in July 2026, bringing specialty contact lens and vision therapy expertise. Sun Optics has organised school eye screenings and cataract surgery camps, alone and with the Jaycees, Lions Club and Rotary Club.

## Brands
- Eyewear: Ray-Ban, Oakley, Calvin Klein, Swarovski, Versace, Giorgio Armani, Armani Exchange, Michael Kors, Montblanc, Jimmy Choo, Maui Jim, Bvlgari, Tommy Hilfiger, Burberry, Police, Coach, David Jones
- Lenses: Zeiss, Hoya, Essilor
- Contact lenses: CooperVision, Bausch + Lomb, Alcon, Johnson & Johnson
- Specialty contact lenses: Classic Lens, Silverline, Menicon, Boston Scleral Lens

## Categories
- Eyewear: full-frame, half-frame, rimless, designer, branded, kids', sunglasses, sports, computer glasses
- Lenses: progressive, blue-cut, photochromic, anti-glare, myopia control
- Contact lenses: soft (daily, monthly, extended wear), toric, multifocal, coloured, specialty (corneal RGP, scleral, orthokeratology)

## Services
- Eye check-up by an optometrist; hospital referral only when a medical examination is needed
- Nose pad change, frame alignment, lens replacement, frame replacement, detailed eyewear and lens consultation
- Corneal RGP lenses (keratoconus, corneal irregularities, high powers); scleral lenses (keratoconus, irregular corneas, severe dry eyes); orthokeratology (overnight lenses to reshape the cornea and help control myopia); vision therapy and orthoptics evaluation
- Trial lenses are available in store; the final specialty lens is custom-made after fitting

## Appointments and fees
Walk-ins welcome for routine check-ups, frames and lenses. Book ahead for keratoconus or corneal irregularity fittings, specialty contact lenses and vision therapy. Eye check-up ₹200, free with a purchase of frames and lenses. Call or WhatsApp +91 95665 14555.

## Branches (10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, all week; Sunday timings may vary)
- Krishna Nagar (since 1999): TKT Complex, 1, Officer's Line, near Lakshmi Theatre, opp. Allen Solly showroom, Krishna Nagar, Veerasamy Nagar, Vellore, Tamil Nadu 632001
- Green Circle: 6/1, Katpadi Main Road, Green Circle, Vellore, Tamil Nadu 632004

## Home delivery
Free within Vellore and surrounding areas; courier service for outer regions. Arrange via +91 95665 14555.

## FAQ
- Do I need a hospital visit for an eye check-up? No; our optometrists check your eyes in store and refer you only when needed.
- Check-up fee? ₹200, free with frames and lenses.
- Appointment needed? Not for routine visits; recommended for specialty fittings and vision therapy.
